verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents several pieces of this story. `pulumi preview` is a plan step that makes no changes, ESC acts as an OIDC provider issuing short-lived cloud credentials, and Pulumi Policies define guardrails whose violations surface in pull request checks. The site also claims agents can work 'without letting them go off the rails.' However, nothing in the evidence shows an explicit approval gate that blocks an agent's apply until a human signs off, or scoping of agent credentials to least privilege. missing for 10: documented human approval/review gate before an agent applies changes, explicit least-privilege scoping of agent credentials, agent-specific enforcement docs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can let an agent plan and apply with least-privilege credentials and review gates so it cannot make unapproved changes

citations.quote: Show a preview of updates to a stack’s resources... No changes to the stack will actually take place.
